findings.steps: Open /sector on the beta as the owner at 390x844 (or 360x740), tab Breadth, scroll to Stock detail, look at the 50 and 200 distance columns.
findings.expected: Every figure readable (the table may scroll sideways, but a cell must not cut its value).
findings.actual: Cells with 4 digits before the point show an ellipsis: '+104.7%' shown as '+104....', '+256.7%' as '+256....', '+114.4%' as '+114....'; the Since date '11 Nov 2025' also cut. td scrollWidth 66 > clientWidth 61 (value) and 94 > 68 (date), text-overflow ellipsis.
